record.one_liner: Commerce platform for online stores, POS and retail; exposes Admin GraphQL, Storefront, Partner and Customer Account APIs.
record.auth_notes: Admin API is called with an access token in X-Shopify-Access-Token, obtained usually via OAuth token exchange. Client ID and secret come from the app's Settings page in the Dev Dashboard; a client_credentials grant also exists for same-organization stores. Storefront API uses its own public/private tokens.
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_free confirmed. Apps are created in the Dev Dashboard (no Partner org needed) and installed on dev stores, which are free testing environments Shopify says you own and control; app plans on your own apps are selectable at no charge. Distribution to many merchants needs app review (see blocker_notes).
record.api_notes: Admin GraphQL API plus Storefront, Partner and Customer Account APIs are documented. REST Admin API is legacy.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready kept. Public-app distribution across many merchants goes through Shopify's app review; custom apps per store do not.
